question: What claim about identity requires a figure freed from wrinkles and grey hair to be designated as a second form of the god of love?
premises: The figure is freed from wrinkles and grey hair.
That figure is identified as the god of love.
It is further designated as the second of its kind.
inference: A wrinkle-and-grey-hair-freed form appears as the second kāmadeva in this context.
plain_english: Freed from wrinkles and grey hair, Kāmadeva appears as the second.
